name: OpenRouter (hosted)
launch: (hosted: nothing to launch) crit config --backend local --local-url https://openrouter.ai/api --model {model}; add openrouter.ai to allowed_hosts; export CRIT_API_KEY=<key>; set local.max_tokens 8192
native_tools: Most listed models support tools; the provider behind a model decides how well. Model ids look like qwen/qwen3.6-27b; profiles match the part after the slash.
cache: Provider-side; usage reports cached tokens for some providers.

needs.max_tokens: local.max_tokens: without it OpenRouter reserves credit for the model's whole output window and refuses with HTTP 402 on a small balance

notes: Sends your prompts to a third party: use synthetic or public code only, never private code (plan/decisions.md).
